facts.fact: Starlink received a 12-month provisional licence in Côte d'Ivoire about a month before 20 July 2026 (so around June 2026).
Starlink launched in Côte d'Ivoire and showed as available, with residential plans at XOF40,244 and residential lite at XOF28,746 a month per the Starlink website.
Orange Côte d'Ivoire launched the satellite broadband service Orange Sat with Eutelsat in January 2026.

The article states Starlink is live in Côte d'Ivoire alongside existing satellite broadband from Orange (Orange Sat with Eutelsat) and an April 2026 MTN-Eutelsat Konnect capacity agreement, so services on two networks, Starlink and Eutelsat Konnect, are on sale.
